raw_record.question_text:
In the transition-state structure shown in the image, calculate the total number of bonds in the structure, including single, double, and triple bonds but excluding those involving hydrogen.

Note: Disregard arrows. Consider all components present in the transition-state structure shown in the image.

method.method_draft: First describe the image and mark all non-arrow straight bond segments in the transition-state structure. Scan systematically from left to right/top to bottom across the left N-containing ring system, the central N+ region, the upper O-bearing chain, and the right Ar-bearing chain. Count each heavy-atom connection once, including the bond to Ar as a heavy-atom bond. Exclude the N-H and O-H bonds because the prompt says to exclude bonds involving hydrogen. The resulting tally of heavy-atom bonds is 20.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个过渡态结构，左侧为含多个氮原子的环状骨架，上方有一个 N-H；中间有一个带正电荷的 N；上方支链连接到 O-H；右侧支链连接到 Ar。图中还有弯箭头，但题目要求忽略箭头。推理计数：只数非氢重原子之间的直线键段，N-H 和 O-H 不计。按指定顺序从左到右扫描：左侧含 N 环系中可见的重原子键段共 11 个；中央 N+ 周围额外参与连接的重原子键段共 3 个；上方通向 O 的重原子链段共 3 个；右侧通向 Ar 的重原子链段共 3 个，其中与 Ar 的连接作为一个重原子键计算。合计 11 + 3 + 3 + 3 = 20。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This is the most direct visual-counting route: it treats the chemical drawing as a set of visible bond strokes and tallies them once, rather than inferring atom degrees or formulas.
planner_metadata.image_role: Inspect the transition-state drawing itself: note the multicyclic N-containing skeleton on the left, the central positively charged N, the O-H group at the upper right, the Ar substituent at the right, and the curved arrows. Read every straight heavy-atom bond line in the structure; do not count the vertical N-H bond or the O-H bond, and do not count any curved arrows.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the prompt instructions that the task asks for the total number of bonds, includes single/double/triple bonds, excludes bonds involving hydrogen, disregards arrows, and considers all components in the image.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use standard skeletal-structure convention: unlabeled vertices/endpoints are heavy atoms, element labels such as N, O, and Ar are heavy-atom sites, and each drawn connection between two heavy atoms counts as one bond unless a double/triple bond is explicitly drawn. In this image the counted connections are the straight heavy-atom bonds only.

method.method_draft: First describe the image as a heavy-atom graph with explicit N/O/Ar labels and implicit carbon vertices. Assign a heavy-atom degree to each visible heavy atom by counting only its straight connections to other heavy atoms; for example, the top N's H connection is omitted, the O-H connection is omitted, and the Ar label contributes only through its single heavy-atom attachment. Sum all these heavy-atom degrees across the whole transition-state structure and divide by 2, because each bond has two endpoints. This graph-degree calculation gives 20 heavy-atom bonds.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一幅过渡态结构式，含有多个显式标注的重原子：左上方有一个带 H 的 N，左侧和左下还有两个 N，中间偏右有一个带正电符号的 N，右上方有一个带 H 的 O，最右侧有一个 Ar 基团。其余线段转折点和端点按有机结构式惯例视为隐含碳原子。图中还有弯曲箭头，但题目要求忽略箭头；N-H 和 O-H 这两条涉及氢的键也不计入。推理：按指定方法，把图像看成重原子图，只数重原子之间的直线连接。Ar 标签只通过它与骨架的一条连接计入一个重原子端点。逐一给所有可见重原子分配重原子度数后，全部重原子度数之和为 40。由于每一条重原子-重原子键在度数和中被它的两个端点各计一次，所以重原子键总数 = 40 / 2 = 20。因此，不含氢键且忽略箭头后的总键数为 20。

It correctly describes the visible heavy-atom labels, ignores curved arrows, excludes N-H and O-H bonds, treats line-angle vertices as carbons, and obtains 20 by halving a heavy-atom degree sum of 40. planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This uses a graph/degree check rather than direct stroke tallying: identify heavy atoms as graph vertices, count each vertex's heavy-atom degree from the image, then apply the handshaking rule to recover the number of bonds. It is therefore computationally different from simply ticking bond lines.
planner_metadata.image_role: From the image, identify the heavy-atom graph: all labeled N and O atoms, the Ar substituent node, and all unlabeled skeletal carbon vertices in the left ring system, central bridge, upper O-bearing chain, and right Ar-bearing chain. For each heavy atom, read how many visible straight bonds connect it to other heavy atoms, while ignoring the curved arrows and the two explicit H attachments.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the prompt to define which graph edges are admissible: include all bond orders if present, ignore arrows, exclude hydrogen-involving edges, and include every component shown in the structure.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Model the structure as an undirected chemical graph. Each heavy-atom bond contributes 1 to the degree of each of its two endpoints, so the number of heavy-atom bonds equals half the sum of all heavy-atom degrees. Do not include degrees contributed by hydrogen atoms.
